schema.description:
Result of `GET /v1/integration/pms` - the PMS reservation/profile
projections and the 30-day inventory rows pass through exactly as the
PMS API shaped them.

inventory.description: 30-day inventory rows (empty when no `property_id` was given).

profile.description: PMS guest profile projection (null when unresolvable).

reservation.description: PMS reservation projection (null when no `reservation_id` was given).

schema.title: PmsDataEnvelope

400.description: Missing property_id for the requested read
